settings.description_override: A favorite shape, made small. The Boat Tote Keychain carries the familiar contrast trim and belted front of a tote into a playful everyday keepsake. Add it to your keys or a bag for a little character that travels with you.
settings.fact_detail: Tiny handles, a textured body and contrast trim give the miniature its charm, finished with a short chain and a gold-tone ring.

settings.heading: Details
settings.content: A miniature tote charm attached by a short chain to a round key ring. Its small belt, handles and fittings belong to the miniature design.

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: Wipe gently with a soft, dry cloth. Keep it away from prolonged moisture and avoid pulling on the miniature handles.

settings.heading: Shipping & delivery
settings.content: Please allow 10 days from your order to dispatch. Delivery time is additional and varies by destination. You will receive tracking details when your order ships. See our shipping policy for delivery information.

settings.heading: Returns
settings.content: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for unused items in their original packaging with tags attached. To arrange a return, contact customerservice@velantrafashion.com. See our return policy for full conditions.
